critical_issues.title: NEW CASE-COLLISION REGRESSION: PROMPTS vs prompts directories
critical_issues.description: A case-collision exists at repository root between PROMPTS/ (uppercase) and prompts/ (lowercase) directories. Both are tracked in git with different contents. On case-insensitive filesystems (Windows macOS), checkout will fail or silently drop files.
critical_issues.root_cause: The prompts/ directory was introduced during Phase 8 WS3 execution. The legacy PROMPTS/ directory was not removed during the case-collision de-duplication task (Track 8.3), likely due to oversight or incomplete scope.
validation_evidence: git ls-files output shows both PROMPTS/* and prompts/* tracked
ls -ld confirms both directories exist at repository root
Case-collision pattern matches Windows safety violation
remediation_steps: STEP 1: Determine canonical name — recommend 'prompts/' (lowercase, matches established convention from Track 8.3)
STEP 2: Merge PROMPTS/ into prompts/: git mv PROMPTS/* prompts/
STEP 3: Remove PROMPTS/: git rm -r PROMPTS/
STEP 4: Verify cleanup: git ls-files | grep -iE '^prompts/' | sort
STEP 5: Commit: git commit -m 'refactor(case): Resolve PROMPTS/prompts case-collision regression'
